packagedExecution.claim: These vectors execute every non-lifecycle SHIPPED packaged handler body from hash-bound source bytes. The engine v7 adapter consumes the canonical HoloScriptPlusParser @trait AST and reparses each preserved authored body through the structured deterministic evaluator; the wasm lane uses its cumulative v6 evaluator. Both statically lift whitelisted factory aliases from @on_spawn, do not execute on_spawn side effects, preserve strict short-circuiting ?? defaults, and carry iterable/callback parameters as the explicit holoscript.std-iterable.v0 and bounded holoscript.std-callable.v0 strict-JSON contracts.

excludedOps.reason: lifecycle side effects are not pure value ABI operations; factory aliases are statically lifted without executing emit or other spawn effects

claimBoundary.note: Executed in Node's WebAssembly runtime against the byte-identical wasm shipped for browsers; a browser smoke run is a separate receipt.
